_apa_ini: External positive control for bge-gemma, ctxl-6B, and FollowIR-7B, with the same protocol as followir.py (FollowIR, NAACL 2025).

cap_gpu.keputusan: auto: weights 14240 MiB do not fit with a gap of 500 (free 14705); GPU cap 13505 MiB, the rest of the weights in RAM

offload.cara: explicit device map from the safetensors header; the modules that fit move back to the GPU after the bf16 cast

implementasi_metrik: imported unchanged from followir.py (adapted from MTEB, see NOTICE.md)

kontrak_inferensi.sumber: README of ContextualAI ctxl-rerank-v2, the Transformers path infer_w_hf copied verbatim
kontrak_inferensi.skor: logit of token id 0 at the last position, cast to bfloat16 and then to float
kontrak_inferensi.slot_instruksi: the instruction is appended after the query with one space; empty means the vendor default
kontrak_inferensi.bos: one, added by the tokenizer (add_bos_token true); the string holds no <s>
